option_relations.rationale: The option 'Post-COVID-19 Reactive Arthritis' is clinically equivalent to the leaf 'Post-COVID-19 reactive arthritis'.
Osteoarthritis is a degenerative joint disease, distinct from reactive arthritis, and not directly related to the provided leaf.
Reactive arthritis (post-viral) is a broader category that includes Post-COVID-19 reactive arthritis as a specific instance.
Post-COVID-19 syndrome with osteoarticular and neurological manifestations is a broader and less specific diagnosis than reactive arthritis, and not directly related to the provided leaf.
